sokkel-egui.note: SortableGrid built before this spec (d163191): drag to reorder; not yet compared with it.

sokkel-tui.note: Not in sokkel-tui's reports as of b99664f.

summary: Cards the reader puts in order, as many across as the room holds. A card is dragged as a whole (or by a grip the app draws in it), the rest moving aside to show where it lands; letting go moves it, and Escape puts it back. With a card focused, the arrow keys move it a place, the focus following it, and Space or Enter picks it up to move it further. A screen reader hears each step.

anatomy.grid: The cards in a grid of as many equal columns as fit, each at least minItemWidth (or the whole width when narrower), 12 apart.
anatomy.item: One card's cell, its content filling it. With handle item, the whole card is the grip: a grab cursor, and the focus outline when reached by keyboard.
anatomy.placeholder: While a card is dragged, its own cell stays in place at 40 percent, as the room it will leave, and the other cards move aside.
anatomy.lifted: The copy that follows the pointer: the drag engine's card (DragDrop), shared by every drag.

itemKey.does: Each card's key, stable across moves.

itemLabel.does: What a screen reader and a grip call a card.

renderItem.does: Draws a card's content, given its place, whether it is dragged, and whether it is the copy following the pointer.

onMove.does: Moves the card at from to to; the grid draws the order it is given.

handle.does: item: the whole card is the grip and takes the focus. grip: the app draws a SortableGrip in each card.

minItemWidth.does: The least width of a cell; the grid fits as many across as its room holds.

kind.does: What a target outside the grid takes its cards as, such as a tree's folders.

label.does: What the grid is, for a screen reader.

focus.means: Keyboard focus on a card (handle item): the focus outline around it.

dragging.means: A card is being moved: its cell stays at 40 percent, a copy follows the pointer, the rest move aside.
dragging.reached: a drag, or Space or Enter on a focused card

rest.note: The card's own look, the app's.

keyboard.does: Reaches each card in turn (handle item), or each grip.
Moves the card a place back, the focus following it; a screen reader hears words.moved.
Moves the card a place on, the focus following it; a screen reader hears words.moved.
Picks the card up to move it further with the arrows; again lets it go there.
Puts a picked-up card back where it was.

sokkel-ui: dnd-kit's sortable with its rect strategy, the library's one drag engine; the keys are the library's own over dnd-kit's keyboard sensor.
The columns are a CSS grid: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(minItemWidth, 100%), 1fr)).
SortableList, the list beside it, is the same group in one column with a grip per row.

drift.today: As of 1a87987, SortableGrid was built (d163191) before this spec, dragging to reorder; not compared with this spec.
As of b99664f its reports name no such part.
